sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as ratio, SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as outpatient_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inpatient_count FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
